title: HitboxCustom
description: A complete revamp of F3+B hitboxes into a powerful tactical tool. Custom opacity, thickness, and colors for 90+ mobs, items, and players.
body:
# 🟣 HitboxCustom

Tired of the default, hard-to-see, eye-burning white hitboxes in Minecraft? **HitboxCustom** completely revamps the vanilla `F3 + B` bounding boxes, turning them into a highly customizable tactical tool for survival, hardcore, and technical play!

---

## ✨ Features

* 📊 Dynamic Entity Categorization:** No more chaotic single-color lines! All 90+ entities are automatically sorted into 5 neat dropdown categories: Hostile, Neutral, Passive, Bosses, and Other Entities.
* 🎯 Individual Mob Customization:** Want Creepers to be neon pink and Zombies to be dark crimson? Every single mob in the game can be assigned its own unique color via a built-in search bar.
* 🤏 Ultra-Thin Outlines: Adjust the edge thickness from a massive `8.0` down to a razor-thin `0.1`. Perfect for late-night gaming sessions to prevent eye strain.
* 🧊 Custom Box Filling: Toggle hitbox transparency/fill from completely invisible (`0.0`) to fully opaque (`1.0`) to get a better sense of entity volume.
* 🎒 Item & Player Support:** Dedicated color sliders for items dropped on the ground and players (visible in 3rd person).
* 👁️ Look Vector Customization:** Toggle or recolor the look line (eye vector) for living entities.
* 📉 **FPS-Friendly Performance:** Built entirely using modern **Gizmos** rendering mechanics. Zero performance drops, zero chunk redraws, even with hundreds of entities nearby.

---

## 🛠️ Configuration & Requirements

To open the settings menu, you will need:
1. **Cloth Config API** (Dependency)
2. **Mod Menu** (To view the mod list and click the configuration gear)

Go to your Mod Menu list, click on **HitboxCustom**, and fine-tune every parameter to your liking in real-time!

---

## 🌍 Supported Languages

The config menu is fully translated into 5 languages:
* English
* Russian
* Spanish
* German
* French

*Note: All 90+ mob names inside the menu are automatically grabbed from Minecraft's registry, meaning they will perfectly match whatever language your game is currently set to!*

---

## 🚀 Future Plans
This is an **Alpha release**. Future updates will focus on hotkeys, health-based color shifts, and potential companion mods for a better vanilla experience. 

Created with pure dedication by _DictatoSteve_.
